name: Al-Mamun Sourov
lead: Developer & co-founder of DŌTED, Bangladesh's marketplace for diecast collectors — and creator of PetBot, a tiny Bangla-speaking desk robot.
about: I build things for the web and for the real world. On the web I design and develop online stores and marketplaces with WordPress, WooCommerce and custom code. On my desk I build small robots and IoT gadgets with ESP8266 and Arduino.
I love projects that people actually use every day — a marketplace where collectors buy, sell and bid, or a little robot that greets you in Bangla, sings, plays games and reminds you to pray.

Phone web app + Telegram bot control from anywhere
Plays football, cricket and flies kites by itself
Birthdays, countdowns, tomorrow's weather, WiFi (OTA) updates
